_note: One-world layout (docs/WORLD-PLAN.md, step 6a). Offsets are integer metres in one ENU frame (x east, z south) centred on Twin Lights (bayshore origin). Each area's content stays in its own local frame and its group is translated by `offset`. Real offsets are kept inside each NJ cluster; the Newark cluster is moved closer (compressed) and joined by a short connector road. Key West is placed over open water east of Sandy Hook and reached by flying (no road).

connectors.note: Compressed stand-in for the real ~40 km Route 36 / Garden State Parkway corridor. Procedural; generic low-detail terrain either side.

ocean.note: Water plane + fog only, so the flight to Key West streams cheaply.
